blocks.text: InN Indonesia - Life Style - Recently water soil citizens have been stirred with the sound of "The Lord of Jesus" being remixed, as well as collaborating with a viral-towering shake in Tickook.
But more surprisingly, the sound of Tickook was not only desired and made content by Christian citizens, but most of them were cursed with religious attributes.
The song "Lord Jesus does not change" is one of the classic Sunday School (Christian children 'worship) that's been sung so often in worship.
The Lord Jesus hasn't changed,
It doesn't change, it doesn't change.
The Lord Jesus hasn't changed,
It hasn't changed forever!
The song is a mystery. In origin, the song was only growing among Christians, not using any specific predictions, the words were repeated, not even sung by K-POP artists, or famous singers.
However, the song that was remixed was successfully through millions of Indonesian warganets. Proved through creative content developed through that sound.
Although the reaping of some spicy criticism from some circles, it does not quench the spirit of the warganet, especially those who stand by Islam to stop using that sound.
Most citizens take a positive path and actually celebrate diversity, tolerance and perspective in the song that's been remix and spread about that creative movement.
Warganet also greets each other and shares the experience of tolerance using that sound in Tickook comments.
"At dawn prayer... it's so good music next door, a greeting tolerance. God bless, "write @ Beautiful Theresiana on the upload that shows itself dancing with that viral sound.
"Why is the song so good? While it's still on the moon of sawawal and the rest of yesterday, please excuse the birth and soul, "write @ Think about in the content.
"Why didn't you tell me we weren't being mean, just singing,"
So, what's the most positive thing to do with this viral content? Is it a coincidence?
Indonesia itself is a nation of diversity, both tribes, languages, religions, culture and many more.
However, diversity has always been kept at the bottom of the country "Pancasila" and also the motto of the country "Bhinnembal Lka" (different but still one jua).
How often conflict has occurred in this country, but always is reunited by Pancasila and Bhinneka Tunnel Ika.

Speaking of pro viral content, while the content is not intended or made up to insult, racist or discriminate against certain religions, it's not a problem, but that's diversity when expressed with liver and values.

Every citizen has the right to express themselves, which is important with the boundaries that need to be maintained, the norm-expression of the nation, and certainly not out of the Pancasila rail and the Tunnel Bhinneka Isa.
To this day, content uses the "Lord Jesus does not change" sound and is still viral and is the favorite sound in ticktock.
